verdict.rationale: Google documents an official MCP server for Google Analytics, which lets AI agents operate GA through natural-language requests (docs-8, probe-3). One hands-on community report confirms a native plain-text query feature ('insights') but says it 'always gets it wrong' (comm-2), so natural-language operation exists but its depth and reliability are unproven. Missing for 10: documented scope of what the MCP server can do (reporting vs. admin/configuration actions), first-party docs for the in-product natural-language query feature, and independent evidence that natural-language queries return accurate results.
